stable_audio_3_litert.access: public, ungated (no token or login required); model licenses still apply

files.role: T5Gemma text encoder (fp16, shared by both models)

files.integrity_note: sha256 recorded from the pinned-revision download in the reference environment; the other four hashes are the publisher LFS values cross-checked in two independent environments.
files.role: SAME-S audio encoder (w8a8 rung); only needed for audio-to-audio / inpainting

notes: The runtime also needs its bundled SentencePiece tokenizer at models/tokenizer.model, which ships inside the runtime checkout (not a separate download).
Generated .xnnwc files next to the weights are XNNPACK inference caches, not model files.
The gated PyTorch repos (stabilityai/stable-audio-3-small-sfx / -small-music, ~3.49 GB each) are an alternative distribution of the same models; this workflow does not use them.
